name: Havu
desc: A former member of the Conch Gang who, despite saying otherwise, desperately wants to rejoin after a falling out. However, in order to maintain his tough-guy persona, he refuses to take the initiative and is thus stuck waiting for his friends to reach out first.

customize.text:
<color=#ffd680>Stage Introduction</color>
It is said that Havu once heard from his Conch Gang companions about a Natlanese dragon whose body coursed with ancient bloodlines, its power unmatched, its size enormous. In Havu's eyes, only a being of such overwhelming strength was worthy of the cards he would wield...
<color=#ebe4d8>Opposing Lineup</color>

customize.name: Goldflame Qucusaur Tyrant
customize.desc:
"Feather of Proclamation" Goldflame Qucusaur Tyrant

A Qucusaurus whose body has attained a supernatural form due to enduring forces that the bodies of modern Saurians cannot control.

customize.name: Lucky Coin
customize.desc: Currency verified and used by the Genius Invokation TCG Society. Can be used to purchase various items related to Genius Invokation TCG. It is said that these coins were initially named as such in the hopes that they would bring those carrying them luck. However, perhaps it is those who are sufficiently lucky who are able to possess them...
